judge.rationale: The candidate only wrote the initial failing acceptance test and `.lore/dod.md`, leaving the production implementation in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` completely untouched. As a result, the added acceptance test fails because `chatOrchestrator` still overwrites `lastUsage` instead of accumulating `totalUsage` across tool rounds. Furthermore, the candidate did not update the `OrchestratorHooks` signature, did not add a `CHANGELOG.md` entry, and merely appended a link to the old under-counting line in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` instead of replacing it with the new behaviour.
